newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ASX substantial shareholding notices - Feb 13.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ASX substantial shareholding notices - Feb 13.

text.p: The following substantial shareholder notices have been made to The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX).
Teck Corporation increased its relevant interest in Camelot Resources NL on 10/02/1997, from 21,555,459 ordinary shares (14.95%) to 36,555,459 ordinary shares (19.8%).
Honore Mining International Ltd Group increased its relevant interest in Forrestania Gold NL on 27/11/1998, from 8,860,000 ordinary shares (12.78%) to 11,580,000 ordinary shares (10.81%).
